# implement-spec ledger — P08.3 Contradiction as a first-class object
- Spec: docs/tickets/P08.3__contradiction-object.md (canonical §31, §28.7)
- Base commit: 74d1658 (devin/p08-2-reconciliation-workflows); Branch: devin/p08-3-contradiction-object
- Package: reconcile/src/reconcile/, tests in tests/reconcile/

## Context (Phase 0.3)
- Precedent (ADR-031/036): reconcile ships thin pure-Python value-object modules; no live Postgres.
  RISK-P8-09 explicitly assigns the materialized Contradiction entity + lifecycle to P08.3.
- Existing `reconcile.model.Contradiction` (frozen dataclass) already carries: contradiction_type,
  subject_id, predicate_id, claim_values, note, severity="notable", status="open", evidence=(),
  research_task_ids=(). Emitted by the resolver (Phase 2.2/2.3) and every §29 workflow.
- DB shape already exists: db/deploy/graph_annotations.sql `contradiction` table
  (contradiction_id uuid, subject_id, predicate_id, contradiction_type, claim_ids uuid[], severity,
   status, resolution_note, resolved_by, resolved_at, research_task_ids uuid[]).
- Resolver (resolve.py): RESOLVE(...) already takes blocking_contradiction:bool -> U7; Resolution has
  contradiction_state ("unresolved_conflict" for open conflicts), input_digest, decision_key
  (excludes computed_at) — already deterministic/reproducible (SIG-RECON-020 core).
- Consumers of Contradiction: tests/acceptance/okc_slice.py + exports read .contradiction_type/.note/.evidence.
  All call-sites use keyword args -> appending optional fields is back-compat.

## Design decisions
- DD1: Promote the EXISTING `reconcile.model.Contradiction` into the first-class materialized entity
  (add identity `contradiction_id`, `claim_ids`, resolution fields, lifecycle methods + validation).
  Keep `claim_values`/`note`/`evidence` (back-compat). Avoids two competing types.
- DD2: Entity + lifecycle modelled in pure Python (aligned with graph_annotations.sql), NO live
  Postgres persistence — continues ADR-031/036 precedent. Recorded as ADR-037.
- DD3: Lifecycle transition methods are intrinsic -> on the dataclass (frozen; return new records,
  never edit in place per SIG-RECON-021 spirit). Orchestration helpers in new contradiction.py.
- DD4: Byte-identical L3 rebuild verified in-process against the resolver (rebuild.py) + committed
  golden sample; CI test regenerates and asserts input_digest + full decision key match.
- DD5: Detector->task contract enforced uniformly: conformance helper + test over §29 workflow
  outputs AND the resolver's Phase-2 contradictions (give the resolver deterministic tasks so the
  whole system is conformant and the rebuild stays byte-identical).

### Deliberate scoping decisions (recorded for the PR)
- Entity modelled in pure Python aligned with graph_annotations.sql; NO Postgres persistence here (ADR-037,
  continues ADR-031/036). Read-API endpoint is P14.1 (out of scope per ticket).
- Existing model.Contradiction PROMOTED (additive) rather than a 2nd type — back-compat; all call-sites keyword.
- reconcile_as_single_count / count_basis_mismatch are refusal/demonstration helpers (P08.2), NOT lifecycle
  detectors; the real predicate_conflation DETECTOR (resolver Phase 2.3) emits a task. Not in the 057 conformance set.
- Out-of-scope confirmed NOT done: resolver U7 test (P08.1), §29 detectors (P08.2), research-task DSL (P10.1),
  public API endpoint shape (P14.1).
